'''Tol Feshin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Employed by [[Basuda]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] of the [[Contraband Resale Corporation]], he resided on [[Carrick Station]] at his master's side.
